t: The Magnusson 18-inch tool bag with wheels offers efficient and organised tool transportation for trade professionals. Constructed from durable polyester with a robust plastic base, this water-resistant tool bag protects contents from the elements. It features an extendable handle and strong wheels, allowing for easy movement of heavy loads up to 18 kg across various work sites. A dual-zipped opening provides convenient access to ten internal and external pockets, including a front-facing zipped storage compartment, loops, and an external tape measure clip to ensure essential tools and accessories are readily accessible and well-organised. This mobile tool storage solution is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders requiring reliable equipment transit.
b: 1 x Front Facing Zipped Storage & 9 x Additional Pocket(s)
